CHASHNI is a concept Diwali gifting brand named after the sugar syrup that binds every mithai, and after the test a halwai uses to judge it: one thread between finger and thumb.CHASHNI is a concept Diwali gifting brand named after the sugar syrup that binds every mithai, and after the test a halwai uses to judge it: one thread between finger and thumb.

Every Diwali the same gift box does the rounds unopened, because nothing on it says what is inside. CHASHNI puts the answer on the lid.

The challenge

Every Diwali, the same gift box does the rounds unopened:

  • Nothing on the box says what is inside
  • So it gets passed on instead of opened

The approach

One mark, one colour variable, four sweets. The pour on the lid and the drawer take the colour of the sweet, so the box names what it holds before anyone opens it.

The identity is bilingual, set in Devanagari and Latin.

The details

The campaign runs on a single line, "This one stops here", which lands three different ways across three reels:

  • The Test: the standard
  • The Count: the problem
  • Keep One: the box you keep for yourself

Concept, identity, packaging and motion by Vivek Kumar. AI was used to generate the kitchen footage (Adobe Firefly, Google Veo), the travertine plate (Google Flow) and the voice (ElevenLabs). Music: paulyudin, "Ambient" (Pixabay).

how it landed

OutcomeOutcome

A concept project, so these are the results it is designed for, not live numbers.

What I delivered

  • A bilingual Devanagari and Latin identity
  • Print-ready packaging with dielines
  • Three reels and three carousels
  • One campaign line across every piece

How I’d measure success

  • Can shoppers name the sweet from the box alone, in a quick shelf test
  • Reel completion and shares during Diwali week
  • How many buyers keep one box for themselves
  • Fewer gift boxes passed on unopened

What it shows

  • A brand name and concept drawn from a cultural detail
  • A packaging system run on one colour variable
  • Bilingual typography
  • A campaign carried across packaging, reels and carousels
